consensus_findings.description: Optional: skills/coordination-bridge/SKILL.md already restates the loop-state-authoritative / queue-is-projection ownership rule that design.md step 7 requires the guide to teach, but coordination-bridge is absent from the proposal Impact allowlist and work-packages write_allow/link set. A grep-style acceptance check for 'skills that previously restated artifact semantics' can miss this source, or the guide and bridge can drift again.

The plan inventory comprehensively covers all five durable state artifact classes (per-change loop-state.json, roadmap checkpoint.json, roadmap learnings, phase records, and handoff documents) with explicit authority rules that prevent advisory handoffs or queue projections from overriding canonical state.

Question-scoped authority and the 7-step fresh-session rehydration algorithm cleanly separate bootstrap location from canonical verification, ensuring missing or stale authoritative state is surfaced as degradation rather than reconstructed from advisory handoffs.

The test strategy uses structural assertions in skills/tests/state-artifacts/test_state_artifacts_guide.py to ensure a clear RED failure on the parent commit and stable GREEN checks after guide/link landing without relying on fragile prose snapshots.

Work package scope, file locks, and dependency allowlists in work-packages.yaml are tightly bounded to documentation, skills, tests, and mirrors, correctly avoiding broad write permissions and justifying the single sequential work-package decision.

Positive observation: The plan inventory matches ri-10's five acceptance classes exactly — per-change loop-state.json, roadmap checkpoint.json, learnings/<item>.md, phase records, and handoff documents — as required in roadmap.yaml acceptance_outcomes and restated in specs/skill-workflow/spec.md.

Positive observation: D2–D3 and the seven-step rehydration algorithm keep authority question-scoped: supervisor/phase handoffs are locator or advisory context only; checkpoint.json and loop-state.json are verified before learnings, phase records, handoffs, or queue projections; missing canonical state degrades rather than being synthesized from advisory data.

Positive observation: Exact paths, holders, writers, consumers, and missing/stale behavior are derivable from current runtime sources without inventing contracts — e.g. openspec/changes/<id>/loop-state.json via autopilot/scripts/runner.py; openspec/roadmaps/<id>/checkpoint.json and learnings/<item>.md via roadmap-runtime checkpoint.py/learning.py; session-log.md plus coordinator/local handoffs via session-log/scripts/phase_record.py; supervise cycle_state._active_changes already fail-loud on missing/malformed loop-state.

Positive observation: The pinned structural suite at skills/tests/state-artifacts/test_state_artifacts_guide.py can RED on the parent commit (guide and test both absent at 1556d815^) and GREEN via field/order/link/mirror assertions without prose snapshots, matching the established docs structural pattern in skills/tests/docs/test_workflow_docs.py and design D4.

Positive observation: The single sequential documentation package is coherent — shared semantic drift boundary across guide, skill links, supervise ordering, tests, and mirrors; explicit write_allow with deny of agent-coordinator runtime; OpenSpec/work-package validation already pass; Non-Goals correctly omit schema/runtime/migration/ADR/security/deploy/browser work for a docs-only surface.

Nit: work-packages.yaml locks.files lists only five skill/docs paths but scope.write_allow also mutates skills/implement-feature/SKILL.md and skills/validate-feature/SKILL.md (and their mirrors). With a single package this is not a parallel-write hazard, yet the lock set understates the declared mutation surface for cross-change concurrency.

FYI: supervise Phase 1 currently reads openspec/supervise/cycle-ledger.json after handoff rehydrate; that ledger is outside ri-10's five classes. Aligning supervise to the guide order should retain the ledger read as supervise-local operational state so idempotency context is not dropped while authority stays on checkpoint.json/loop-state.json.
